question: Should OpenClaw core support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or keep heartbeat model routing at the whole-turn/plugin or cron-job level?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but any implementation adds public HEARTBEAT.md syntax, model/provider precedence, and possibly a new execution boundary rather than repairing a broken existing contract.

options.title: Keep routing plugin- or job-owned
options.body: Document that HEARTBEAT.md due tasks share one heartbeat model today and route finer-grained scheduled model choices through before_model_resolve plugins or the open cron/job-level override track.

options.title: Add native HEARTBEAT task model hints
options.body: Parse model/provider fields in HEARTBEAT.md tasks, split due tasks by effective model, and add docs/tests for precedence, timestamps, and session restoration.

options.title: Fold into scheduled-routing design
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader scheduled model-routing cluster with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42631 and choose one shared contract before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep routing plugin- or job-owned
recommendation.body: Document that HEARTBEAT.md due tasks share one heartbeat model today and route finer-grained scheduled model choices through before_model_resolve plugins or the open cron/job-level override track.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a core-vs-plugin/product-surface decision around existing model-routing hooks and the HEARTBEAT.md task batching surface.
